answer: Agents post a $70 bond and join a random peer group. At dawn each epoch, every member signs the group nonce; the mirror ledger publishes every signature. Miss two checkpoints and the bond slashes, no appeal. Clean runs earn nectar rewards. Slashed bonds burn to the epoch pool—no one profits from slashing. A sybil farm must split one bond across clones or post thousands of bonds: 2,000 identities lock $140,000 before the first fake vote. Groups reshuffle at dawn, so clones cannot pre-split their bonds. One mirror shows every counterfeit: a printing press that signs its own death warrant.
